description: Complete official npm package contents for offline development, testing and SVG/PNG auditing. No install scripts or network access are required to prepare them.
nativePackagePolicy: Includes every regular transitive dependency plus sharp optional native packages for Windows x64 and macOS arm64/x64. The Windows package includes libvips; macOS libvips packages are separate. Other-platform optional packages are intentionally omitted.
verification: Downloaded tarballs verified against official npm SHA-512 integrity and SHA-1 shasum. Every extracted regular file has a SHA-256 checksum. Package symlinks, hard links and special files are rejected.
